name: Universal Intermodal Services - Harvey Chicago Operations Center - Harvey IL

fieldNotes.locate: Re-resolved to 250 E 167th St, Harvey IL 60426 — Universal Intermodal Services' Chicago operations center. The EARLIER audit geocoded the wrong building (an older brick industrial building on a mixed residential block) and was flagged low-confidence; this re-audit uses the confirmed address and pins the actual operating drayage yard. Google geocode returned 41.5877278,-87.6439306. Satellite confirms a large open container/chassis drayage yard with an office and maintenance buildings, sitting directly against the CN Harvey rail corridor.
fieldNotes.facilityNature: An open intermodal/drayage yard — NOT a warehouse. The site is a large paved lot used for chassis storage, container storage, and drayage-tractor parking, with a small office building and maintenance/repair shop buildings. There is essentially no dock-warehouse function.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The yard is fully enclosed by chain-link fence along E 167th St. Street View (Jul 2024) shows a defined truck-entrance pinch-point — a wide paved gate opening in the fence line off 167th St. truckGate = true (controlled fenced perimeter with a single defined entrance).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed standalone guard booth observed at the gate opening — a fenced entrance with no median booth and no barrier arm visible. Check-in is presumed handled at the interior office building. Classed remoteGs = true; guardShack flagged uncertain (a small gate booth could exist but is not visible in imagery).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No warehouse dock bank. The maintenance/repair shop buildings have a handful of service-bay doors only — dockDoors 0-10 (effectively a maintenance shop, not loading docks).
fieldNotes.drop: The dominant feature is massive chassis and container storage — hundreds of chassis in skeletal rows plus stacked containers across the open lot. dropArea 50+, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.railServed: The CN Harvey (CN Gateway) intermodal rail corridor runs immediately west of the yard, and the yard exists to dray containers to/from that ramp — but NO rail spur runs into this property itself. railServed = false.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very large open paved yard with abundant unused width at the entrance — ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Harvey IL is inside the dense south-suburban Chicago metro fabric — Urban.
fieldNotes.geofences: Perimeter captures the fenced drayage yard: ~290 m N-S x ~292 m E-W ≈ 21 acres. dropYards boxes cover the chassis/container storage blocks; truckGate box is the 167th St entrance pinch-point.
